openings.claim: Bind immutable source bytes to one visible request/download identity; distinguish binding from selection failure.
openings.discriminator: Requested/worker hash mismatch indicates binding; matching hashes but unintended downloaded identity indicates selection. Both may occur.
openings.fit: Preserves constraints; snapshot/display effort remains unverified.
openings.probe: Stage reversed completions with fabricated sources; compare editor intent, request pair, worker hashes, output and download identity.
openings.uncertainty: Missing historical fields prevent attribution; reproduction proves possibilities only. Editors must recognize identities.

openings.claim: Coalescing obsolete pending requests may reduce waiting.
openings.discriminator: Late final-request starts support queue delay; prompt completion followed by late identification supports interpretation delay.
openings.fit: Preserves running jobs, embedded rendering and delivered history; budget fit assumed.
openings.probe: Join render and selection/viewing timestamps; replay sequences omitting obsolete pending jobs and estimate savings.
openings.uncertainty: Single-correction successes limit blanket rendering explanations; festival demand remains unknown.

openings.claim: Private browser audition of an explicitly selected caption snapshot could bypass preview renders while retaining embedded delivery.
openings.discriminator: Faster correct judgment with matching embedded wording/timing supports audition; discrepancies or unchanged times weaken it.
openings.fit: Uncertain prototype effort and playback/composition fidelity.
openings.probe: Two editors compare labeled fabricated video/two-revision audition against embedded output, including timing boundaries and changed cuts; separate waiting, choosing and watching.
openings.uncertainty: Requires private playback, immutable snapshots, recognizable pairing and faithful output agreement.

lineage.reason: Merged with A2; retains identity mechanism and causal test.
Merged with Z1; preserves historical attribution limits.

decision: Diagnose first; select implementation from results. All probes share four engineer-days, one editor-day and 80 processing hours/week, use existing private accounts, retain embedded delivery and access to last delivery/original captions. Meter processing. Synthetic observations establish no efficacy; subsequent 30 sessions must yield at least 27 timely correct previews and zero unintended pairings.
